_doc: uniqueTournament.id values excluded from FOOTBALL counting samples (PLAN §6.1).
A friendly is played at a different intensity from a league match; its corners,
cards and fouls describe a different game. Keyed on the id, never on the name,
because the name is localised and the id is not.
Every entry names the evidence file the id was read from. An id nobody can
trace to a payload does not belong in this file. Extend it with
review each candidate before promoting it here.
